subject: Math
subskill: Word Problem - Setup and Solve Inequality
prompt: Derek needs at least $250$ canned food items to meet his food drive goal. If Derek has already collected $85$ canned food items, what is the minimum number of additional canned food items Derek needs to meet his goal?
explanation: Choice B is correct. Let $x$ represent the number of additional canned food items Derek needs. After collecting $x$ additional items, Derek will have a total of $85 + x$ items. Since Derek needs at least $250$ items, $85 + x \geq 250$. Subtracting $85$ from both sides yields $x \geq 165$. Therefore, the minimum number of additional canned food items Derek needs is $165$.
